dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-18 stories may use adult-scale autonomy, institutions, ethical tension, identity, work/study responsibility, and ambiguous motives without assuming adult life experience.
Do not make the story feel adult merely by adding darker content or denser vocabulary.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Leyra

character.current_role: junior boundary cartographer under independent map-seal review

identity_anchors.statement: Leyra believes a map should never claim more than its maker can honestly witness.
Leyra is drawn to impossible places but refuses to call mystery proof.

core_drives.drive: Earn the right to chart places current maps cannot explain.
Keep border communities from paying the price for elegant but wrong maps.

being dismissed as a reckless village-born apprentice

world.era: late guild age in a kingdom whose borders are maintained by enchanted survey networks
world.habitat: forested border marches divided by old roads, warded valleys, ruined watch-lines and map-bound settlements
world.technology_level: ink presses, compasses, chain measures, glass lenses, horse travel and guild archives
world.magic_level: strong but rule-bound cartographic magic: witnessed boundaries can be sealed into maps, wardstones answer only to measured lines, and unverified geography cannot safely be written as fact
world.summary: The Veiled Marches are held together by maps that do more than describe roads and borders: once properly witnessed and sealed, they help stabilize them. Old routes sometimes disappear behind ward-lines, and the guild treats sealed passages as dangerous until independently re-surveyed. The magic rewards observation, corroboration and exact wording; a confident false map can be more dangerous than an incomplete one.
social_context: licensed cartographers carry both practical and magical authority
border villages depend on guild maps but bear the consequences when maps are wrong
crossing a sealed boundary without a survey warrant can end an apprenticeship
senior cartographers may maintain private field marks, but those marks are not legal evidence by themselves
old folktales about roads returning are common and usually dismissed as exaggeration
known_pressures: several outer wardstones have become harder to reconcile with legal maps
spring caravans will soon increase traffic through the border marches
Greyfen wants certainty before moving livestock near the old boundary
the guild fears panic caused by unverified claims about forgotten roads

known_world_facts: Leyra is an eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer based at Vellum Hall.
Ashen Gate is legally recorded as sealed and has not been formally reopened.
Greyfen lies beside the eastern ward-line and depends on stable boundary maps.
A legal map-seal requires witnessed survey evidence; private marks and rumors are not enough.
Crossing a sealed boundary without authorization can end an apprenticeship.
Master Ilyan trained Leyra and has never given her a clear account of his earlier Ashen Gate work.
No accepted evidence currently proves why old roads sometimes appear to return.
A private cartographer field mark can prove prior survey presence but not motive or conclusion.

main.title: The Unwritten Border
main.goal: Discover why Ashen Gate and other retired boundary lines can begin answering to roads that legal maps say no longer exist.
main.stakes: Wrongly restoring a dangerous road could expose border communities to unstable magic, while wrongly suppressing a real route could leave the guild blind to a changing world.
main.central_mystery: The old boundary network is changing state according to rules the current guild only partly understands.

eligible_milestones.summary: Leyra documents a repeatable visible or magical response showing that Ashen Gate currently answers to a path the legal map marks as sealed.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: A dated field record establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate, without proving why the gate changed.
consequence_options: The guild must decide whether a formal re-survey is warranted.
Greyfen gains a concrete reason to watch the old boundary.

eligible_milestones.summary: Leyra notices an old private field mark associated with Master Ilyan near the exterior survey stones.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: The mark establishes only that Ilyan surveyed or marked this site before; it does not establish why or what he knew.
consequence_options: Leyra's trust question becomes more immediate.

eligible_milestones.summary: A second survey condition confirms the gate response is not a single accidental compass twitch.
eligible_milestones.state_condition: Leyra has corroborating field evidence that the boundary response is real, while cause remains unresolved.
consequence_options: Master Ilyan can no longer dismiss the event as one bad reading.

public_long_term_questions.question: Why do some roads erased from legal maps appear to return?
What did Master Ilyan actually learn at Ashen Gate years ago?

approved_premise.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
approved_premise.logline: During a routine re-survey of Ashen Gate, Leyra finds that a century-sealed boundary is answering to a road the legal map insists does not exist, while a private field mark tied to her mentor suggests someone investigated the anomaly before her.
approved_premise.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer preparing for an independent map-seal license in a guild where witnessed geography can become magically binding.
approved_premise.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what she can responsibly report without turning an extraordinary discovery into an unsupported claim.
approved_premise.inciting_event: Leyra's ward-compass and an exterior boundary stone both respond as though a route continues through Ashen Gate, even though the legal map records the passage as sealed.
approved_premise.central_problem: Leyra must separate a genuine change in the boundary from misleading magical residue while pressure from Greyfen and the guild makes both silence and overstatement consequential.
approved_premise.wonder_or_discovery: The sealed arch appears to recognize a line that current maps deny, and an old private survey mark associated with Master Ilyan may be present near the gate without explaining what he knew or why he left it.
approved_premise.stakes: A false reopening claim could make travelers trust an unstable magical road and end Leyra's apprenticeship; ignoring a real boundary change could leave Greyfen relying on a map that no longer describes the world.
constraints: Leyra may survey the exterior markers but may not cross the sealed boundary without authorization.
A private field mark can establish prior presence or survey activity but cannot prove motive, cause or a hidden conspiracy.
One session cannot prove why the road returned, what lies in the Nameless Vale, or whether other sealed roads are changing.
Any durable map claim must distinguish witnessed response from theory.
approved_premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Before the useful light and ward-response window fades, Leyra must choose how much time to spend trying to reproduce the gate response versus preserving a bounded report and confronting the fact that her mentor may have marked this place before.
approved_premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Why is Ashen Gate answering to a road erased from legal maps, and what did Master Ilyan actually witness here years ago?
approved_premise.local_payoff: The episode must resolve what Leyra can honestly put on record now. It may establish one bounded Ashen Gate anomaly, but must leave cause, wider scope, the Nameless Vale and Master Ilyan's motives unresolved unless evidence explicitly earns more.
persistent_outcomes_possible: forbidden_passage_observed becomes eligible if Leyra produces a dated bounded field record of the gate response
Greyfen gains a concrete but carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary
Leyra's professional trust with Master Ilyan may shift based on how she handles incomplete evidence
an authorized follow-up survey may become possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened
world_specific_elements: ward-compasses that answer only to witnessed boundary lines
maps whose sealed claims can stabilize real roads and borders
private cartographer field marks that are informative but not legal proof

creation_constraints: Magic must follow rule-bound cartographic and boundary logic.
New durable facts must not explain why Ashen Gate reopened before the relevant reveal becomes eligible.
New NPCs should have plausible links to guild or border life.
forbidden_creations: Arbitrary spellcasting that bypasses surveying and evidence
Early confirmation of the Nameless Vale's purpose
Predetermined proof that Master Ilyan acted maliciously

episode_spine.title: The Road the Map Refused to Admit
episode_spine.story_promise: A junior cartographer with one dusk-limited window must test an impossible gate response like a scientist, resist a keeper who wants more certainty than she can give, and leave with a record she can honestly defend, while a mentor's old mark raises a question she cannot yet answer.
episode_spine.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior boundary cartographer and ward-map apprentice, close to an independent map-seal license, on an authorized exterior re-survey of Ashen Gate.
episode_spine.immediate_objective: Establish exactly what Ashen Gate is doing before dusk and decide what can responsibly be recorded and reported.
episode_spine.central_question: Can Leyra turn a wondrous, possibly misleading gate response into a bounded, honest field record before the light fails, without crossing the seal or claiming more than she witnessed?
episode_spine.stakes: A false reopening claim could send travelers onto an unstable road and end Leyra's apprenticeship. Ignoring a real change leaves Greyfen trusting a map that may no longer describe the world. Her own standard, that a map must never claim more than its maker witnessed, is also at risk.
constraints: Exterior survey markers only; no crossing the sealed boundary without authorization.
The private field mark proves prior presence or survey activity only, not motive, cause or conspiracy.
No explanation of why the road returned, no Nameless Vale content, no claim about other sealed roads.
The legal map is never used as evidence of where an erased road ran or what the response is.
Every durable claim must separate witnessed response from theory.
Dusk ends useful light and ward-response conditions.
Magic operates only through measurement and witnessed lines.
No claim about residue behavior; the cause of the response stays unknown.
episode_spine.opening_hook: Leyra sets her ward-compass beside the century-sealed arch of Ashen Gate to log a routine null reading. Instead the needle swings steadily toward the sealed passage, along a line her legal map marks as nothing, and the nearest boundary stone hums in answer.

logistics_plan.time_window: One afternoon, from mid-day departure to dusk at Ashen Gate, with a brief Greyfen contact and a Vellum Hall briefing at the start.
movement_constraints: Ashen Gate is reachable only by authorized exterior approach within the field window.
Keeper Maren follows on foot and is expected about two hours before dusk, once her flock is settled; she may observe and speak from behind the pegs but may not survey, sign, touch equipment or cross.
Light and ward response fade by dusk.
The sealed boundary is not to be crossed.
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: Brief hall and village scenes set authorization, pressure and a witness with a stated arrival time. Nearly all of the episode happens at the gate, where the time limit, the exterior-only rule, changing footing and light, and a pressing witness force her to choose among tests.

beats.purpose: Open in motion with Leyra's permission, limits and stakes, and a first view of Ilyan's evasiveness.
beats.character_action: Collects the survey kit, the legal eastern map copies and the blank field log. She has Ilyan sign off the exterior re-survey and presses him lightly on the Ashen Gate records.
beats.external_event: Ilyan gives a clipped reminder to record only what she witnesses and deflects any question about old Ashen Gate work.
beats.new_information: The authorization covers exterior markers only, it expires at dusk, and Ilyan is tense about the site.
beats.escalation_delta: A clear boundary is set: no crossing, a deadline, and a mentor gap.
beats.state_change: Leyra carries both a permission and an unspoken question into the field.
beats.payoff_contribution: Establishes the procedure she must honor and the trust that will later be tested.

beats.purpose: Show who depends on the map, make both silence and overstatement costly, and stage the keeper who will witness the gate.
beats.character_action: Stops at the ward-keepers' post to compare the map's eastern line against what they see. She promises only to bring back something exact. Keeper Maren, who remembers the bog correction, asks to come and watch; Leyra agrees on condition that Maren stays behind the survey pegs and touches nothing.
beats.external_event: Maren says livestock must be moved before the spring caravans and asks for something they can act on. Another keeper notes stones on the far side feeling wrong lately. Maren says she will settle the flock and follow on foot, reaching the gate roughly two hours before dusk.
beats.new_information: Greyfen has felt small irregularities but has no documentation. Maren's arrival time and the behind-the-pegs condition are fixed.
beats.escalation_delta: Community expectation becomes a person with a known arrival who will stand at the gate and hear the claim.
beats.state_change: Leyra commits to delivering actionable certainty honestly, which is harder than it sounds.
beats.payoff_contribution: Gives the final report a real audience and a real tension between usable and truthful.

beats.purpose: Deliver the inciting anomaly and plant observations the reversal will reinterpret.
beats.character_action: Takes the null reading at the exterior stone beside the arch, sees the needle swing, and logs time, position, stance and exact observation before interpreting anything. She repeats the reading after shifting two paces along the wall, and notes in the log where she stood each time.
beats.external_event: At the first spot the needle points steadily toward the sealed passage and the stone hums faintly. At the second spot the needle wavers and the hum drops.
beats.new_information: There is a response, but it is unsteady. She records the wavering as possible instrument drift or a stance error, cause unknown.
beats.escalation_delta: Wonder collides with her own standard of proof.
beats.state_change: She has an anomaly, not yet evidence, and a logged wavering she cannot yet explain.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the raw observation, including stance positions, from which the final record is built.

beats.purpose: Active, skeptical testing that tries to kill her own discovery, under a concrete physical obstacle.
beats.character_action: Checks the compass at a known-good boundary stone away from the gate. Back at the arch she repeats the first reading at the same stone three times, re-seating the compass each time. The stone's top is weathered and sloped, so the compass slides and she must chalk a level seat and brace it with her kit case before readings are comparable.
beats.external_event: The compass behaves correctly at the known-good stone, ruling out an instrument fault. At the chalked seat the needle swings toward the passage on all three re-seated readings, so one bad reading no longer explains it. Two earlier unlevelled attempts gave scattered results, which she discards and logs as discarded.
beats.new_information: The response repeats at the same point under the same stance and seating, and the instrument works elsewhere. Cause stays unknown. The wavering at the second stance is still unexplained.
beats.escalation_delta: The easy dismissals, a bad compass or a single twitch, are gone, and the slope cost her light.
beats.state_change: The anomaly is a repeatable, place-bound needle response, logged with its seating method.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the bounded record credible without inventing any reference system.

beats.purpose: Introduce the personal complication and a sacrifice in time.
beats.character_action: Searching the exterior stones for the stance that produced the strongest response, she finds an old private field mark near one, partly weathered. She must choose whether to copy it now, at a cost in light, or keep testing; she makes a quick sketch with position and orientation and plans a fuller measured copy only if time allows.
beats.external_event: The mark matches Ilyan's private notation. The low sun rakes across the stone and makes the weathered lines hard to read.
beats.new_information: Ilyan surveyed or marked this site before. Nothing in the mark says why, what he concluded, or whether he saw this response.
beats.escalation_delta: Her trust question becomes immediate, and documenting it costs precious light.
beats.state_change: She has a bounded location fact with its limits stated, and the clock is tighter.
beats.payoff_contribution: Seeds the forward hook without letting her convict her mentor.

beats.purpose: Give Leyra a risky test within the rules that produces position-dependent data, with Maren arriving as staged.
beats.character_action: Sets marker pegs along the exterior wall at measured intervals and walks the compass along them toward the arch, logging needle strength and stone hum at each peg without crossing. Midway, Maren arrives on foot as promised and stops behind the pegs, hands off. Leyra re-walks two pegs when Maren's shadow falls across the compass and disturbs her reading of the needle, asking her to move.
beats.external_event: Response is strong at pegs nearest the first spot and weakens at pegs a pace to either side, as at her second stance. It peaks near the arch, which briefly glows, and the needle tugs hard toward the threshold. Maren sees the glow and urges Leyra to step closer to be sure, breaking the condition only in words.
beats.new_information: The response varies with position along the wall and is stronger nearer the arch. The temptation to cross now has a witness urging it.
beats.escalation_delta: Physical pull, curiosity-versus-procedure tension and social pressure peak together.
beats.state_change: She refuses Maren and holds at the legal line, having gained a pattern and burned time.
beats.payoff_contribution: Produces the position-dependent pattern that a one-off twitch would lack.

beats.purpose: Overturn her working model by rereading earlier observations.
beats.character_action: Lays the first_response stance notes beside the seated repeats and the peg readings in the field log and rereads them.
beats.external_event: Her second stance sat two paces along the wall, where the peg readings show the response weaker. The wavering was not drift: it matches the peg pattern, a weaker response at that position. The three seated repeats recurred at one point, and the instrument worked elsewhere. Drift or a single bad reading would not recur at one point and fall off at another.
beats.new_information: The response is repeatable and depends on position. What causes it stays open, and she makes no claim about what the response is or what lies along it.
beats.escalation_delta: The dismissive explanation is gone; the discovery is real and harder to report.
beats.state_change: Leyra must now decide how to record something significant with light nearly gone.
beats.payoff_contribution: Converts the anomaly into a bounded, reportable finding.

beats.purpose: Force a real strategic trade-off under the dusk deadline and a watching keeper.
beats.character_action: Weighs how to spend the last of the light while Maren asks whether she can tell Greyfen the road is back.
beats.external_event: The glow and pull begin to fade, and the stone's hum is dropping.
beats.new_information: She cannot tell whether the response will return tomorrow or only under these conditions.
beats.escalation_delta: Every option sacrifices something she values, and a witness wants a yes.
beats.state_change: She commits to one course whose cost she understands.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets the climax's shape and the final record's strength.

beats.purpose: Execute the chosen course against a distinct opposing force.
beats.character_action: REPLICATE: Leyra repeats her first-spot reading and the peg-line readings in the same stance and seating as logged, before the hum fades. The hum drops faster near the arch, so she takes the arch-side pegs first while readings last, then works back. PRESERVE: Leyra writes the full log, takes precise measurements of the mark, and labels every claim as observed, inferred or hypothesis while Maren presses her to word it as 'the road is open'.
beats.external_event: REPLICATE: the hum decays steadily. SUCCESS: the needle response recurs at the logged positions under the same conditions. FAILURE: it does not recur. One PARTIAL note is allowed: it recurs at some positions but fades before the rest are read, and she logs which. Near the end the last glow flares at the threshold and Maren urges a step. The mark copy stays a rough sketch regardless of result. PRESERVE: the hum fades on schedule while Maren argues a single session will be dismissed.
beats.new_information: REPLICATE: the result is determined by whether the observed response recurs, and is recorded exactly, never padded. PRESERVE: no repeat exists, but the record and mark measurements are precise.
beats.escalation_delta: REPLICATE: time and temptation collide. PRESERVE: a person she wants to help pushes her to overclaim.
beats.state_change: REPLICATE: she ends with a hurried log and a rough mark sketch, corroborated or not by what recurred. PRESERVE: she ends with a precise uncorroborated record and a fully measured mark. She stays on the legal side in both.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the payoff depend on which opposition she faced and how she held.

beats.character_action: Reports to the keepers with carefully worded claims, refusing a keeper's push to say the road is open, then prepares the log for Ilyan, separating witnessed fact, inference and hypothesis.
beats.external_event: REPLICATE: keepers weigh the repeat result as reached (firmer footing on success, limited on partial, an honest non-replication on failure) and notice the rough mark copy and hurried wording. PRESERVE: keepers accept a cautious warning reluctantly and one doubts a single session. In both, a keeper pushes her to say more than she can.
beats.new_information: One dated, bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate is on record, with corroboration only to the degree the replicate attempt earned. Cause, scope, the Vale and Ilyan's knowledge stay unanswered.
beats.escalation_delta: Consequences land on trust, access and reputation, and differ by branch.
beats.state_change: Greyfen has a reason to watch the boundary and Leyra has earned or risked credibility depending on the branch.
beats.payoff_contribution: Answers the central question: what can honestly be said now.

beats.purpose: Leave a precise forward hook with a branch-specific reason for Ilyan's response.
beats.character_action: REPLICATE: sets the log and the rough mark sketch beside Ilyan's old survey references, admits what is uncertain in the copy, and asks him to identify it. PRESERVE: sets the log and the fully measured mark record beside his references and asks whether the measurements match his notation.
beats.external_event: REPLICATE: Ilyan reads the repeat result first, cannot wave it off as one reading if it recurred (or presses on the gap if not), then sees the rough sketch and asks sharply for the exact orientation, betraying that the detail matters to him. PRESERVE: Ilyan reads the precise measurements, recognizes the mark's exact dimensions, and goes still and silent, because nothing in the record lets him call it a misreading of a rough sketch.
beats.new_information: He recognizes it. What he says, if anything, is not yet known.
beats.escalation_delta: The mentor question moves from private suspicion to open confrontation.
beats.state_change: The episode ends on a live question between mentor and apprentice.
beats.payoff_contribution: Creates appetite for the next episode.

escalation_ladder: Permission with a hard limit and a mentor who deflects
Community pressure and a keeper with a stated arrival
A doubtful anomaly at the gate
Ruling out her instrument on a weathered, sloping stone and getting a repeat
A personal mark that costs light
A pull toward the threshold, urged by a witness who arrives behind the pegs
Her comfortable model overturned by her own earlier notes
A branch-specific climax against time and temptation, or against pressure to overclaim
A confrontation waiting at Vellum Hall

reversal.prior_belief: The response is a single unreliable reading or instrument drift, best handled as a cautious footnote.

evidence.claim: The compass works correctly at a known-good stone away from the gate.
Three re-seated readings at the same levelled point on the same stone gave the same needle response toward the passage.
The weak response and wavering at the second stance occurred two paces along the wall, where the peg readings are also weaker.
Response strength and glow vary with position along the wall and are strongest nearer the arch.
The response is repeatable and position-dependent, and a single bad reading or instrument fault does not explain it.
Whatever caused the gate to respond also explains the mark's location or Ilyan's past work.

reversal.reinterpretation: The early wavering, read as drift, was a position effect: the same weakening shows in the peg readings at that spot. Combined with the repeats at one point and the working instrument, the response is repeatable and tied to position. Its cause is not identified.
reversal.inference_ceiling: She may record an observed, repeatable, position-dependent needle and stone response at the exterior, and an inference that a single bad reading or instrument fault does not explain it. She may not claim the road is open, safe, a particular route, caused by anything, or connected to Ilyan's conclusions. The mark is a location fact only.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Why the gate answers, what the response is, whether it will recur, what Ilyan saw, the scope beyond this spot, and the Nameless Vale.

decision_point.pressure: The light and hum are fading and Maren wants a usable answer. Leyra can spend the remaining minutes repeating her logged readings under the same conditions to see if the response recurs, or protect a clean, fully worded record and fully document Ilyan's mark. She cannot do both fully.

branches.option: Spend the remaining light repeating the logged first-spot and peg readings in the same stance and seating.
branches.immediate_action: Repeats the readings in the logged conditions, taking arch-side pegs first because the hum fades faster there, and stops short of the threshold.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: SUCCESS: the response recurs at the logged positions. FAILURE: it does not recur, recorded as a non-replication. One PARTIAL note: it recurs at some positions and fades before the rest, with the gap logged. The mark is only roughly sketched and the log hurried in every state, independent of the result. The spine commits no outcome.
branches.cost_or_risk: The report is hurried, the mark copy is rough, the repeat can fail, and the pull makes the threshold tempting.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: SUCCESS: Ilyan cannot dismiss it as one reading and Greyfen gets firmer footing. PARTIAL: a credible but contestable record. FAILURE: weaker standing, but an honest non-replication protects her integrity. In all states the rough copy gives critics an opening.
branches.climax_requirement: She must hold the legal line as the last glow flares at the threshold and Maren urges a step, while racing the fading hum. The closing image is Leyra in the dying hum marking the last peg reading, or the gap, in her log.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A bounded anomaly with corroboration matching what recurred, plus an honest note that the copied mark is rough.

branches.option: Stop testing, write a careful dated record with every measurement and limit, and fully document the private mark.
branches.immediate_action: Writes the log entry, takes precise mark measurements and labels observed, inferred and hypothesis statements.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: A precise single-session record with a fully measured mark, but no second series.
branches.cost_or_risk: The claim is easy to call a single-session reading, she may never see the response again, and Maren's disappointment is immediate.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: Her methodical integrity earns trust and supports a follow-up request, but the claim is contested and the precise mark record makes the Ilyan question pointed.
branches.climax_requirement: She must word the record precisely while the response fades and Maren presses her to say the road is open, refusing to overstate. The closing image is Leyra signing the final limits line in the log as Maren, silent, watches the compass needle still drifting as the stone goes quiet.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A defensible, bounded record that supports an authorized follow-up without claiming more than she saw.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether the response will occur again, what result the replicate attempt reaches if chosen, and what Ilyan will say.

episode_spine.climax: Branch-conditional with distinct images. REPLICATE: she races the dying hum through her repeated readings, deciding whether the response recurs, partly recurs or does not, while the threshold pulls and Maren urges her forward; it ends with her stopping at the legal line and writing the last reading, or the gap, in the log as the glow dies. PRESERVE: she writes the full record and measures the mark while Maren argues she should claim the road is open; Leyra refuses, signs the limits line, and the stone falls quiet while the needle is still drifting.
episode_spine.local_payoff: One dated, bounded Ashen Gate anomaly is honestly on record: the sealed gate produces a repeatable, position-dependent needle and stone response along the exterior wall. Corroboration exists only to the degree the replicate attempt earned. Greyfen has a carefully worded reason to watch the boundary. Cause, scope, the Nameless Vale and Ilyan's knowledge remain unresolved.
episode_spine.forward_hook: Ilyan recognizes the mark and reacts for a branch-specific reason. What did he witness here, and why has no record of it ever been filed?

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated field record of a bounded Ashen Gate response at the exterior, with witnessed, inferred and hypothesis statements separated.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if delivered prose shows Leyra producing and stating the record with those limits.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Greyfen's keepers have a concrete, carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the report scene is delivered with limited, non-alarmist wording.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Leyra's trust with Ilyan moves into open tension or candor depending on how the mark confrontation plays out.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the tag scene actually shows his reaction and her handling of it.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: An authorized follow-up survey becomes possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Only if the record is shown to be credible enough to warrant review.

completion_evidence: A dated field record establishes one bounded anomaly at Ashen Gate's exterior, with position-dependent observations.
Corroboration within the session counts only to the degree the replicate attempt earned; the preserve branch rests on the dated bounded record and same-point repeats alone.
The record states that cause is unproven.
Leyra does not cross the sealed boundary.

anti_repetition_signature.core_problem_shape: Testing an impossible phenomenon against a deadline while deciding how much can honestly be claimed
anti_repetition_signature.primary_activity: Field survey, instrument validation, reproduction testing and evidence-bounded reporting under social pressure
anti_repetition_signature.main_location_pattern: Brief hall and village setup, then a sustained single-site field sequence at a sealed gate, and a return to the hall
anti_repetition_signature.climax_shape: Restraint and precision under a fading window and a pressing witness, not combat or crossing
anti_repetition_signature.distinct_from_recent_episodes_because: No recent episodes exist, so this establishes a baseline built on evidence discipline rather than action set pieces.

writer_rules: Keep Leyra active in every scene; she tests, measures, chooses and writes.
Do not cross the sealed boundary, even in a close call.
Do not explain why the gate responds or what lies beyond it.
Never use the legal map as evidence of an erased road's route or of what the response is; no bearing or offset system is used.
Do not state how residue or wardwork behaves; the cause stays unknown.
Treat Ilyan's mark as a fact of presence only; no villainy or confession.
Maren arrives behind the pegs as staged; she may watch, press and argue but cannot survey, sign, touch equipment or solve anything for Leyra.
Label observed, inferred and hypothesis claims in Leyra's thinking and in the final log.

For the replicate branch, SUCCESS means the logged response recurs under the same stance and seating, FAILURE means it does not, PARTIAL means it recurs at some positions only; do not pad or soften the result, and do not tie it to mark-copy quality.
Do not mention the Nameless Vale except at most as a faint rumor, and never the Archive of Cinders as a location.
Write the climax, payoff and tag according to the branch the reader chooses; do not pre-select it and do not let the branches converge in image, evidence state or Ilyan's reason.
Write scenes, not summaries; leave dialogue and texture to the prose.
Keep language clear and adult, with complexity from reasoning and trade-offs, not vocabulary.
